display.title: Rosh Chodesh Kislev: Friendship Brings Moshiach (Another Copy)
display.summary_short: Another copy of Uncle Yossi's Rosh Chodesh Kislev talk: Ahavas Yisroel, true friendship among Jews, is the key to ending the golus.
display.summary_long: A holiday talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, broadcast the day before Rosh Chodesh Kislev. Kislev is the month of miracles, the month of Chanukah. On Shabbos Mevarchim we prayed that Hashem, who did miracles for our fathers and redeemed them, should redeem us very soon. Uncle Yossi lets children in on a secret hidden in the next words, 'chaveirim kol Yisrael', all Jews are friends: the key that unlocks the golus is Ahavas Yisroel. Tzivos Hashem's soldiers fight the worst enemy, sinas chinam, hating someone for no reason, by loving and helping one another. He prays that this Kislev bring the greatest miracle of all, Moshiach, who will carry us on heavenly clouds to Eretz Yisroel, where the Kohen Gadol will again light the golden menorah in the third Beis HaMikdash. This copy is the same recording as 'Rosh Chodesh Kislev 350', starting a moment later.
display.lesson: Love and help every Jew; true friendship among Jews is what brings Moshiach.
